`end_turn` result."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- 💬 **Chat inside Obsidian** — prompt DSH from the Agent Client side panel.
- 🧰 **Tool-call frames**"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" — tool cards render in the client (`in_progress` →
`completed`), with token usage per step. *(needs"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" a tool-capable model)*
- 🗂️ **Session management** — durable session list, **fork**, **resume**, an"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"d

- 🧠 **Reasoning & live streaming** — live reasoning / execution display in long
mode (insid"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"e a dsh web profile).
- 📥 **Import external sessions** — import a session exported by another ACP
ag"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"ent (e.g. Claude / Agent Client) into the local DSH session store.
- 🩺 **Self-check & one-click repa"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"ir** — `dsh-acp doctor` diagnoses environment
drift and can repair most issues automatically.
- 🧹 **"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"Automatic cleanup** — orphaned sessions are reconciled against Obsidian's
own session list (conserva"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"tively; live sessions are never removed)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Registered as a custom agent, running a conversation, and browsing session

- **Obsidian*"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"* with the **Agent Client** community plugin (for the Obsidian path)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### One-click (recommended)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The package ships a parameterized installer that (a) installs the plugin into a

up** every file before touching it, supports **any Obsidian vaul"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"t**, and can be
previewed with `--dry-run`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Run `./install.sh --help` for every option (`--profile`, `--dsh-home`,

"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"(add `-DryRun` to preview, `-Uninstall` to restore). It writes `DSH_BIN` pointing
at the `dsh.cmd` s"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"him and separates the plugin-target profile from the adapter
runtime profile."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Manual (Obsidian Agent Client)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. Install and enable the **Agent Client** community plugin
(Settings → Community plugins → Browse →"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" "Agent Client").
2. Settings → **Custom Agents** → **Add**, and fill in:
- **ID**: `dsh-acp`
- **Di"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"splay name**: `DeepSeek Harness (ACP)`
- **Command**: absolute path to this package's `dsh-acp.mjs`
"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"- **Args**: *(empty)*
3. Set the plugin's **`nodePath`** to a real `node` binary (>= 22.13).
4. Relo"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ad Obsidian (`Cmd/Ctrl-R`) and pick *DeepSeek Harness (ACP)* in the agent
picker."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"> **`customAgent.env` is an array of `{ key, value }` objects — not `"KEY=VALUE"` strings.**
> Agent"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" Client builds the child env from that array; a plain string entry is
> silently ignored."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"1. **Pick a tool-capable model** in the session panel before your first prompt

Tool-call frames only appear when the model sup"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ports tool/function calling.
